requirement: The checker must not evaluate or reject the contents of a string-valued justification, including an empty string.
justification: Scenarios: empty string and explicitly non-probative explanation still pass when snapshots match; non-string justification fails schema validation. The field is deserialized as a string but never read during validation. The subprocess tests demonstrate ignored contents independently from format enforcement. Validated with cargo test --locked --offline --manifest-path language-lab-ci/Cargo.toml (20 tests passing). Each cited test uses isolated fixture files and asserts outcomes, not merely the presence of instructions.
